checks.detail: A fire-and-forget BridgeTalk body without frontend calls ran in AME in 1 s (it wrote a file). The S10 body never returned from fe.addCompToBatch(aep, epr, out): AME stayed PUMPING for 15+ min with the queue empty, with AE idle and the fixture closed; AME ignored a normal close. A waiting AE (bt.send with timeout or a pump loop) deadlocks both. Fallback: AE Render Queue or aerender with the Output Module template (part a: works).
checks.name: diagnosis: BridgeTalk reaches AME 26.5.2; addCompToBatch hangs

fallback: Экспорт из AE через Render Queue или aerender с шаблоном Output Module, повторяющим брендовый `.epr`; шаблон создаёт панель или пользователь загружает по инструкции — по итогу S10 (§8.1)
